title: Reviewing CSS Essentials 🎨
description: Recap selectors, box model, specificity, typography, and backgrounds.

slides.title: CSS: The Presentation Layer 🎭
slides.content:
# Core Concepts Checklist

- **Selectors** target elements: type, class (`.class`), ID (`#id`), attribute, combinators, pseudo‑classes/elements.
- **Box Model**: content → padding → border → margin. Default `content-box`; reset to `border-box` globally.
- **Specificity**: inline > ID > class/attribute > type. Keep specificity low with classes.
- **Cascade & Inheritance**: later rules override earlier if specificity equal; some properties inherit (`color`, `font-family`).
- **Units**: `px` for borders, `rem`/`em` for fonts, `%`/`fr` for layouts, `vw`/`vh` for viewport.

Master these and you master CSS.

slides.title: Global Reset & Base Styles

quizData.question: Why do we set `box-sizing: border-box;` globally?

options.text: So that width/height includes padding and border, making layouts predictable
It's required for Flexbox to work

slides.title: Typography & Colors Refresher ✍️
slides.content:
# Readable and Beautiful

- Use `font-family` with fallback stack.
- Set sizes in `rem` for scalability.
- `line-height: 1.5`–`1.7` for body text.
- Contrast ratio ≥ 4.5:1 for normal text.
- Use `clamp()` for fluid headings: `font-size: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4rem);`
- Colors: hex, rgb/rgba, hsl/hsla; use CSS custom properties (`--color`) for theming.

slides.title: Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Use Custom Properties

Define a design system in `:root`: `--color-primary: #3498db;` and reuse with `var(--color-primary)`. Makes global changes instant.
